_comment: T-2432 (design Sec2.5): one entry per geometry site the four grounding/temper/audit/fold passes found. `family` is R1 (re-derives hidden_size==num_attention_heads*head_dim), QOW (uses hidden_size as a stand-in for q_proj's/o_proj's true width), or KLP (assumes one K-landing path). `status` is fixed, confirmed-correct, rejected (a defined convert/load-time rejection, not a code fix), or not-yet-built (a Track this build did not own). GS-01..GS-04, GS-06..GS-19 are Track A's own scope (T-2432); GS-05 is Track B's (D-SLM5243), out of this ticket's scope and not yet built. GS-26/GS-27 (T-2441) are RunGreedyDecodeLoop/RunGreedyOrDampedGreedyDecodeLoop's own num_attention_heads threading (Critical 1, D-SLM5431). `required_tokens` (T-2441, S2 fix, D-SLM5436): for a `fixed` site, the literal substring(s) that must appear on or after the site's own marker line, before the next marker in the same file (or end of file) -- ANY one of the listed tokens satisfies the check at that occurrence. Present ONLY on `fixed` sites: `confirmed-correct` sites are intentionally unchanged by this ask (their own governing quantity is correctly hidden_size/intermediate_size, not q_width), so a presence check would be backwards for them, and `not-yet-built` sites have no code to check yet. Derived once, by reading each site's own diff against v1.3.0 (2f225fc..327ee29) -- see tools/geometry_site_census.py's own module docstring for how the census applies this field.

sites.note: Track B's own scope (D-SLM5243); a defined convert/load-time rejection, not built by T-2432.
